Meze tavern with a garden · Agios Dometios, Nicosia

Meze in the garden by the crossing

Cypriot meze, grills and kleftiko in a big garden next to the Agios Dometios crossing, with live music on many evenings. On Google, 4.5 stars from 666 reviews.

Food

What comes to the table

From what guests write in their Google reviews.

Meze

44 reviews mention the meze. Guests write that the plates keep coming until you can hardly get up from the table.

Souvlaki and sheftalia

From the grill. 15 reviews mention the souvlaki, 10 the sheftalia; others name the lamb chops.

Kleftiko

Kleftiko comes with potatoes and salad. 9 reviews mention the kleftiko, one calls it the best dish of all.

Halloumi and starters

Grilled halloumi, mushrooms, dips and village salad open the meze, as the photos from the tavern show.

The garden and the kitchen

Photos from the Google listing of Odofragma Tavern.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Live music

22 reviews mention live music, especially on Fridays and Saturdays, with Greek songs and dancing.

A big garden

Guests describe a big garden and a cool courtyard with plenty of space, and parking behind the tavern.

Book on weekends

On Friday and Saturday nights the tavern fills up, so guests recommend booking a table.

A tavern by the crossing

The tavern sits right by the Agios Dometios crossing point, which is where its name comes from, as one guest explains. Guests eat in a garden under trees and a wooden pergola, between old chairs, cart wheels and an old piano. It is open Tuesday to Sunday from 19:00.

What guests say

Three of 666 Google reviews, 445 of them with five stars.

“Traditional Cypriot "tavern", where plates with delicious meze keep on coming until you can't get up of the table. Great outdoor environment”
